final: WITH per AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS a FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) AS v FROM orderexecutions), s1 AS (SELECT per.a AS a FROM per, b1 WHERE per.a > b1.v), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM s1), s2 AS (SELECT s1.a AS a FROM s1, b2 WHERE s1.a > b2.v) SELECT AVG(s2.a) AS avg_of_avgs, AVG(s2.a - b1.v) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(s2.a - b2.v) AS avg_excess_second FROM s2, b1, b2
